title: What is new card: scrim, a 720px flat panel, left title, one Got it
why: The critic scored the What is new card 2 of 5: no scrim so the station labels fought it, a 1560px slab, a centred amber title and no primary. Now a scrim, a 720px flat panel with a rule, the title top-left in tx-1 and one amber Got it bottom-right with the dismiss hint on the left. Drawing only; the text, the stamp and the dismiss rules are unchanged.
now: What is new card: cleaner layout and a Got it button.

edits.replacement: wnW=Math.min(_wnWW-LH(60),LH(460));   // v28.xx (cw-wnew40) critic on screen 40 (2 of 5): "1560px slab". The card is a 720px card now (the style guide: a modal never exceeds its content).

wnH+=LH(34);   // v28.xx (cw-wnew40): room for the footer row (Got it)
    var wnX=_wnWW/2-wnW/2, wnY=_wnHH/2-wnH/2-LH(10);

edits.anchor: ctx.fillText((PAD&&PAD.on)?'walk to dismiss':'press ENTER or walk to dismiss',_wnWW/2,wnY+wnH-LH(12));
